'''Tractor Beam 12''' was a [[tractor beam]] control unit located in [[Section N-Six/Canon|Section N6]] on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. When a [[YT-1300 light freighter]] named the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was captured by the station's tractor beam, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was the passenger of the ship, turned off the device in order to allow the ''Falcon'' to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|escape]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tractor Beam 12 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The text on the tractor beam was displayed in [[Wikipedia:English language|English]], however, it was replaced with [[Aurebesh]] in the [[Star Wars Trilogy (DVD)|2004 DVD release]].
